FX-SPLIT2-001.says: The settings as they start: from 25, 50 to 75, 50, both sides 50: Split's picture as it starts (FX-SPLIT-001).

FX-SPLIT2-002.says: Both sides 4: Split's picture with split 4 (FX-SPLIT-002).

FX-SPLIT2-003.says: Split 1 4, Split 2 0: only the upper side opens, the rows above the line pushed up and squeezed; every row below the line untouched.

FX-SPLIT2-004.says: Split 1 0, Split 2 4: only the lower side opens; every row above the line untouched.

FX-SPLIT2-006.says: Both points at 50, 50: the drawing, untouched.

FX-SPLIT2-007.says: From 50, 10 to 50, 90, Split 1 4, Split 2 0: walking down the screen your left is the right of the picture, so only the right half opens.

FX-SPLIT2-008.says: From 10, 10 to 90, 90, Split 1 3, Split 2 6: torn along the diagonal, the lower left side opened twice as far.

FX-SPLIT2-009.says: Split 1 keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 8 at frame 4, linear, Split 2 4: frame 0 FX-SPLIT2-004, frame 2 FX-SPLIT2-002.

FX-SPLIT2-010.says: Split 2 keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 8 at frame 4, Split 1 0: frame 0 the drawing, frame 2 FX-SPLIT2-004.

FX-SPLIT2-011.says: FX-SPLIT2-003 moved three pixels right: the same, moved; nothing grows.

FX-SPLIT2-012.says: Split 2 eased from 0 at frame 0 to 1000 at frame 4 on a curve that overshoots, Split 1 0: at frame 2 it would pass 1000 and is held there.

FX-SPLIT2-013.says: FX-SPLIT2-003 with the points swapped: the sides swap, so the lower side opens, FX-SPLIT2-004's picture.

FX-SPLIT2-014.says: From -50, 50 to 150, 50, Split 1 6, Split 2 2: the points off the drawing, the tear right across it, opened 3 up and 1 down at the middle.

FX-SPLIT2-015.says: Split 1 1001, above 1000. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-SPLIT2-016.says: Split 2 -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-SPLIT2-017.says: Point A at 1001, 50, past ten widths. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-SPLIT2-018.says: Point B at 50, -1001, past ten heights. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-SPLIT2-019.says: Split 2 keyed to 1500 at frame 4. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
